newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse up in active first-tier trading.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse up in active first-tier trading.

text.p: Two Bucharest bourse high- caps remained at centre-stage on Tuesday, leading turnover up to 6.2 billion lei from 3.6 billion in the previous session.

Share prices of 16 companies edged higher in heavier demand, six stocks drifted lower, three remained unchanged and two had no trade. Two companies remained suspended, pending announcements on their latest shareholders' meetings.

Two independent indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- rose from the previous session by 3.7 and 3.52 percent respectively at 521 and 538.37 points. The BIG first-tier index was 1,746.72 points, 3.89 percent up on the previous session.
First-tier Oltchim chemical plant and fertiliser maker Azomures had more than 2.5 billion lei in turnover, mostly from cross deals.

Oltchim had a special trade -- a large deal struck outside the market and reported to the exchange later -- involving 490,000 shares totalling over 713 million lei. It gained 56 lei to close at 1,456. Azomures stayed flat at 1,760 lei.

Pharmaceuticals company Terapia, which moved to the higher trading level on Tuesday, had 128 million lei in turnover. It gained 100 lei to end at 2,750 despite brokers' expectations for a fall in its quote, in line with the other first-tier prices.
Policolor dye maker dominated the second-tier, where trading was more active, with volumes almost doubling to some 320,000 shares. It closed 90 lei firmer at 1,790.
Newcomer Prodvinalco had only two deals involving 274 shares. It ended the day flat on its opening at 500 lei.
Syringe maker Sanevit, returned to the market after a four-session suspension pending details on a shareholders' meeting, closed at 10,000 lei, 1,000 up on its price before suspension.
The VAB index is displayed on VANGUARD.
